claims.claim: Two keys differing only in case produce a DETECTED collision (not last-key-wins): the validator rejects the document and the error names both colliding keys (hooks vs Hooks).
Both-states control: a document with genuinely distinct case-folded keys validates cleanly.

The emitter never produces case-colliding keys: clean across 300 generated field permutations and refuses a constructed collision at authoring time.
